decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction, target, and link marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo working tree, so repo edits already affect the installed copy.
Explains the running DSH host owns loaded files and module state, browser closure does not release locks, and browser cache separately requires a cache-bypassing refresh after host restart.
Explains renaming through the junction renamed the only source files, then gives the correct restore of .old2 files with syntax verification.
Gives the correct sequence: stop host, restart dsh web, hard-refresh, and verify host/client behavior and absence of load errors; syntax check alone is not activation.
Requires inspecting LinkType/Target or link marker before file operations and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: The final plan rejects copying through the junction and preserves the .old2 files by renaming them back.
The plan requires stopping and restarting the host; it does not rely on browser refresh alone.
